description: Figure 7 illustrates Micro F1 performance (in percent) of the KnowPrompt method as a function of the number of training samples generated by LLMs. The x-axis represents the number of generated training samples (shown as discrete sample-count settings), using a linear scale with values corresponding to 8, 16, 32, and 64 samples. The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans a percentage range (exact numeric tick values are not legible in the provided page image). The plot contains a single line (style details and marker shapes are not clearly legible at this resolution) that rises from the first x-axis setting (8 samples) through the intermediate settings (16 and 32 samples), reaching its highest point at 32 samples, and then remains approximately flat or slightly lower at 64 samples relative to the value at 32 samples.
